status.choose_profile: Choose a profile before viewing reviewed records.
status.no_profile: I could not match that to a profile. Try just the person's name, or browse profiles.
status.records: These are the reviewed cases and context records for the selected profile.
status.no_reviewed_records: No reviewed records are available for this profile. This does not mean no cases exist, or establish guilt or innocence.
status.withheld: Research is being reviewed. Case and context records are currently withheld.
status.unavailable: Reviewed research is temporarily unavailable. Try again later; this does not mean records are absent.
status.profile_not_found: That profile is no longer available. Choose another profile.

reviewedChat.scope: I show reviewed cases and context, not answers to open-ended questions. I cannot establish guilt, innocence, or who you should vote for. Other profile fields are outside this reviewed-record view.
reviewedChat.moreProfiles: More profiles match. Enter a fuller name to narrow the choices.
reviewedChat.moreRecords: {count} more reviewed records are available on the profile.
reviewedChat.eventOrder: Events follow record ID order. Partial or unknown dates do not establish chronology.
reviewedChat.refresh: Previous answers were cleared. Send again to check current reviewed records.
reviewedChat.sourceMissing: No separate source is attached to this event. Consult the record sources.
reviewedChat.coverage: This view shows reviewed cases and context. Coverage can be incomplete.

status.records: Here are matching filings from the reviewed 20th Congress sample.
status.choose_profile: Choose a profile before viewing its reviewed Senate filings.
status.no_profile: I could not match that to a loaded reviewed Senate profile or filing title. Try a surname, one SBN number, or a short title.
status.no_matching_filings: No matching filing is available in this reviewed sample. This does not mean no filings exist.
status.outside_coverage: This reviewed batch cannot establish that. It covers selected 20th Congress proposals. Try one bill number, a name, or a short title. It does not provide voting advice or impact ratings.
status.not_loaded: Matching reviewed records are not available in this installation. This does not establish that the person filed nothing.
status.needs_review: Matching stored records differ from the approved batch and are withheld pending review.
status.unavailable: Reviewed Senate filings are temporarily unavailable. Try again later; this does not mean records are absent.
status.profile_not_found: That profile is no longer available. Choose another person.

senateChat.enactmentUnknown: Enactment is not verified in this batch.
senateChat.scope: These are selected proposals, not complete career totals. Filing does not establish enactment. Bill status, current office and social impact remain unverified. Title and topic matches use literal words and are not exhaustive.
senateChat.remaining: {count} more matching filings are in this selected sample. Consult the dataset for the full list.
senateChat.moreProfiles: More profiles match. Use a fuller name to narrow the choices.
senateChat.combinedScope: Answers use reviewed Senate filings or separately reviewed cases and context. Coverage can be incomplete.

reviewedComparison.title: Compare the reviewed records
reviewedComparison.scope: These are selected filings in the same 20th Congress batch. The list is incomplete. A larger sample count does not establish better performance, exclusive authorship, or enactment.
reviewedComparison.selected: {count, plural, one {# selected filing in this batch} other {# selected filings in this batch}}
reviewedComparison.unavailable: Reviewed filing details are unavailable or need review. This does not mean the person filed nothing.
reviewedComparison.missing: Bill status, enacted outcomes, finances, attendance, votes and full career totals have not been verified in this batch. Missing information is not zero.
reviewedComparison.otherFields: Other comparison fields: not yet verified
